name: WaH-NeRF
aliases: Where and How: Mitigating Confusion in Neural Radiance Fields from Sparse Inputs
definition: A novel learning framework for Neural Radiance Fields from Sparse inputs (NeRF-S) that mitigates rendering confusion by addressing two root causes: sample-position confusion ('WHERE to Sample?') and prediction confusion ('HOW to Predict?').
summary: WaH-NeRF is a sparse-input NeRF framework that mitigates rendering confusion by predicting sampling offsets and using semi-supervised learning, rather than relying on post-rendering regularization.
